Protein Food

Crab

About This Entry

Crab is sweet shell-on crustacean — blue crab steams and cakes. Crisp whites, lager-friendly Sauvignon, and dry rosé suit Old Bay and drawn butter.

Beginner Guide

Blue crab is representative; Dungeness and other species are distinct future expansions.

FAQ

What is Crab?
Blue crab is representative; Dungeness and other species are distinct future expansions.
How should Crab be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
